content: This information is intended for your general understanding and is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. It is essential to consult your healthcare professional for detailed guidance regarding this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of severe side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, potentially leading to inaccurate results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your doctor. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests may be required to monitor your progress. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Taking outdated tetracycline can lead to serious illness. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always seek complete information from your healthcare professional regarding this product and your specific health requirements.
